convert_pfm_to_flo_batch: run a script that batch converts PFM optical flow files listed in a text file to FLO format
convert_left_flow_pfm_to_flo: run the script to convert all left PFM flow files to FLO format using flowlib
convert_right_flow_pfm_to_flo: run the script to convert all right PFM flow files to FLO format using flowlib
use_pfm_to_flo_api: use the flowlib pfm_to_flo function to convert a single PFM flow file to FLO format
review_convert_flow_format_script: review the convert_flow_format script that batch converts PFM to FLO optical flow files
